episodes.title: Dilema
episodes.summary: Victor, a millionaire newspaper publisher, gets a blackmail note just as Mónica, a reporter, is about to break a Syrian war story that implicates him.

episodes.title: Azar
episodes.summary: The plot thickens when the extortionists make good on their threats, but also throw Victor a lifeline when he least expects it.

episodes.title: Culpa
episodes.summary: As more and more people die under mysterious circumstances, Victor's guilt hits a zenith and his world begins to crumble. Protests erupt in Madrid.

episodes.title: Grieta
episodes.summary: After Victor confesses everything to Mónica, she begins to have doubts. Meanwhile, Detective Conte becomes obsessed with the case.

episodes.title: Salida
episodes.summary: After Mónica distances herself, Victor takes a gamble with Conte to foil Midas, and tries to redistribute his fortune. The protests continue.

episodes.title: Lucha
episodes.summary: At a crossroads, Victor must decide how he will proceed. And absolutely everything — love, his family and his fortune — hang in the balance.
